packageRules.description: Restores the default for peer ranges, which `rangeStrategy` above would otherwise override. Peer ranges are deliberately wide, so they get broadened rather than raised.
Mirrors npmPreapprovedPackages in .yarnrc.yml, which exempts these from the install-time age gate.

Packages published from a single upstream repository, which Renovate's monorepo data is missing. Without a group each package gets its own pull request and they all conflict over the same manifests and changelogs.
